objective: Register the existing Phase 6C, Phase 7, and Phase 8 pytest markers in the repository's canonical pytest configuration so strict marker validation succeeds without changing test selection, assertions, warning filters, or product behavior.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml remains the sole pytest configuration source and registers every custom Phase marker currently referenced by repository tests: phase6c_cp1_inference_page, phase6c_cp2_inference_page_lifecycle, phase6c_cp3_inference_results, phase6c_cp4_main_window_integration, phase7_cp2_inference_bundle_discovery, phase8_cp1_atomic_artifact_io_primitives, phase8_cp2_atomic_portable_artifact_writers, and phase8_cp3_atomic_bundle_workflow_graduation.
Each marker has a concise, accurate description that identifies its checkpoint scope, with no duplicate names or aliases for the same meaning.

The change does not rename markers, modify test bodies, add skip or xfail behavior, weaken assertions, alter test discovery or selection, or suppress warnings through filterwarnings or global ignore rules.
The fixed allowlisted pytest command runs all modules that currently use the registered Phase markers with --strict-markers and passes without PytestUnknownMarkWarning.
Built-in and plugin-provided markers such as parametrize and skipif are not redundantly registered by the project.
No product code, test source, dependency, README, documentation, goal, manifest, user setting, or runtime state is changed by the checkpoint implementation.

Python 3.11 future-annotation imports and TorchScript serialization APIs remain unchanged because investigation found no future-import defect and torch.export migration is outside this maintenance scope.
claude_prompt: Implement only Phase 9 checkpoint 1 by minimally editing pyproject.toml. Add pytest marker registry entries for the eight existing Phase markers named in the acceptance criteria, each with a concise checkpoint-specific description. Preserve all existing project and pytest settings. Do not add filterwarnings, warning ignores, aliases, skip/xfail behavior, dependencies, or unrelated formatting. Do not rename markers or edit any test, product, documentation, goal, manifest, runtime, or user-settings file. Do not alter from __future__ imports or TorchScript APIs. Do not use Bash or Git, do not run tests, and do not implement later work.
estimated_scope: Very small maintenance change: one pytest configuration table in pyproject.toml, approximately 8-15 added lines.
